translations.web: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God; for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
translations.kjv: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
